hot_takes.text: Episode 1 confirmed ready to enter filming after years of funding fights.
Kongthup announced three supporting-cast changes for Love Bound and confirmed the November 2026 premiere window.
Lingling named Most Beautiful Woman Alive 2026 in the annual fan vote. A fan-vote poll, not an industry jury.
Both named Entertainment Leaders at Lifestyle Asia 50 Icons 2026.
Official Juliet & Juliet trailer released, locking the Sep 5 premiere on one31 with uncut on oneD.
First Khom Khlang teaser released ahead of the Sep 7 WeTV premiere.
Full official trailer followed the teaser.
Second PLS Love teaser pinned Friday Sep 11, 8:30 PM GMT+7, Channel 3 and 3Plus.
